scenarios.prompt: A station recipe consumes two materials and creates one item. Define a stable recipe/version and one atomic transaction into inventory overflow handling.

criteria.recipe: Stable recipe/version plus explicit inputs/context/outputs define the transform.
criteria.transactions: Reservation/consume/output/overflow commit is atomic or resumable and idempotent.
criteria.evidence: Missing input, full inventory, duplicate submit, interruption and migration are tested.
